name: agentic-cybersecurity-demo-tooling
description: Repo-root DEV tooling only (Prettier + the Playwright browser test). Not deployed — the box installs lab/orchestrator deps, never this.
//: Prettier formats the whole repo (see .prettierrc / .prettierignore). printWidth 120 is set deliberately: it matches the existing long-line style and keeps the reflow of the 16 KB-capped, user_data-inlined server.js/agent.js small. Terraform (.tf) is handled by `terraform fmt`, not prettier. http-proxy is here only for the test-browser edge shim (it stands in for Caddy), never shipped.
